preconditions.description: The number of possible splits m is between 1 and 100000.
The number of different monster types n is between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= mi <= n for mi, li, *rest in splits)
preconditions.description: Each monster ID mi in the split rules is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(li >= 1 for mi, li, *rest in splits)
preconditions.description: Each split rule has at least one monster or diamond.

preconditions.expression: sum(li for mi, li, *rest in splits) <= 100000
preconditions.description: The sum of li across all split rules is at most 100000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines, one for each monster type.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(smallest, int) and isinstance(largest, int) for smallest, largest in result)
postconditions.description: Each line contains two integers: the smallest and the largest number of diamonds.

postconditions.expression: all(-2 <= smallest <= 314000000 for smallest, largest in result)
postconditions.description: The smallest number of diamonds is between -2 and 314000000.

postconditions.expression: all(-2 <= largest <= 314000000 for smallest, largest in result)
postconditions.description: The largest number of diamonds is between -2 and 314000000.

postconditions.expression: all(smallest == -1 if largest == -1 else True for smallest, largest in result)
postconditions.description: If the largest number of diamonds is -1, the smallest number of diamonds is also -1.
